text:
alex: Quick compatibility check — runtime PR #4827 changed the inference header behaviour (now requires X-RI-Model-Version). I merged it to release/candidate but it may require SDK updates. Cutoff for release window is Fri 2026-03-20 23:59 PT. Can SDK/console owners confirm if this is a minor or patch bump? Also need changelog line. @sam @maria @jordan

maria: saw the header change, thanks. Python SDK already has a draft PR (python-sdk#213) that accepts X-RI-Model-Version optional. Should be a patch if we're only adding header handling; but runtime also updated response shape for streaming tokens — that might be semver-minor.

sam: I'm on it. I'll run the integration matrix locally against the candidate branch. ETA 90m. If streaming shape changed, console might need UI adapt — cc @jordan.

jordan: console can handle missing fields but relies on `chunk_type` in stream. If it's renamed we need a quick shim. Will review console PR once CI finishes. If only additive fields, prefer patch. :eyes: 

luis: release-bot just reported CI: release-candidate -> failing flaky tests in runtime-integration (timeout). logs: ```/opt/runner/logs/runtime-integ.log: 503 on stream test at 27s```

release-bot: build 1785604321 completed: unit ✅, integration ❌. Creating issue #rel-483 to track.

alex: Thanks. Decision call: if streaming shape is incompatible (rename/required), we do a minor across runtime + SDKs + console. If it's additive/optional, patch runtime + patch SDKs. Can each owner post PR numbers and a short compatibility note here so I can update release notes? Also tag changelog entries as 'breaking' if minor.

maria: python-sdk#213 opened (patch candidate). Note: backwards compatible — old clients ignore new header. test matrix green locally.

sam: js-sdk#198 will add header logic; PR coming in 30m. If streaming shape is minor, I'll include compatibility shim. Matrix run command: ```./scripts/run-matrix --branch release/candidate --services api,runtime,console --timeout 10m```

jordan: console#77 is ready with shim for token stream. If we go minor I'll flip the flag to use new field. Tests: console-e2e passed against stubbed runtime.

alex: Perfect. Please add a one-line changelog snippet in respective repo CHANGELOG.md with PR link. I'll assemble release notes. Final cutoff again Fri 2026-03-20 23:59 PT — after that only security/critical fixes. Ping me when PRs merged. :shipit:

maria: merged python-sdk#213 -> release/candidate (patch).

sam: js-sdk#198 opened, draft status. Matrix run in progress.

release-bot: matrix run started (id: mr-890).

luis: runtime-integration retry fixed timeout — rerun green. runtime#4827 remains merged.

alex: thanks — last ask: can someone post the compatibility matrix rows (columns: repo, semver, notes) so I can paste into release docs?

jordan: console | patch | shim added to tolerate new stream field; no UI changes.

maria: python-sdk | patch | accepts optional header, no behavioral change.

sam: js-sdk | patch -> minor fallback | adds header; includes fallback shim for renamed streaming token; recommended minor only if runtime enforced required field.

alex: ok I'll mark release as 'patch' unless runtime team confirms required rename. Will call out upgrade notes for SDKs. If anything changes by EOD ping here.
